Takashi (Japanese: '''タカシ''' ''Takashi'') is the main character of [[Pocket Monsters HeartGold & SoulSilver Go! Go! Pokéathlon]]. He is based on the {{ga|Ethan|male player character of HeartGold and SoulSilver}}.

==Character==
Takashi is upbeat and determined, though also reckless. He is a bit airheaded at times. He has a strong bond with his Pokémon.

==History==
Takashi is the protagonist of [[Pocket Monsters HeartGold & SoulSilver Go! Go! Pokéathlon]], with other characters playing only minor roles. 

He competes in the [[Pokéathlon]] and loses all the games he competes in, causing him to mope. He is reassured by {{ga|Lyra}} and given [[Aprijuice]] to use in the next competition. When the next day comes, it is revealed that instead of giving the Aprijuice to his {{p|Chikorita}}, he had drank it, showing his impulsiveness. He ended up winning the match however, and is excited for the rest of the competition to come.
